A6.claim: TROP2-high samples have higher tumor fraction and lower CD8/NK in public scRNA
A6.verdict: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED only as a composition artifact; NOT supported as a lineage-restricted immune-exclusion phenotype

honest_split.all_cell_TACSTD2: Higher epithelial/tumor fraction is essentially tautological (GSE131907 tLung Spearman rho=0.945, p=1.1e-5, n=11; mixed tumor origins rho=0.56 vs author malignant fraction and 0.89 vs epithelial fraction). CD8 fraction is lower in mixed origins (rho=-0.52, p=0.001, n=37) but not in primary tLung alone (rho=-0.21, p=0.54). NK is not lower (tLung rho=+0.04; mixed rho=-0.11, p=0.50).
honest_split.epithelial_or_malignant_TACSTD2: Does not associate with higher tumor fraction or lower CD8. tLung epithelial TACSTD2 vs CD8 rho=+0.38, p=0.25. Mixed-origin malignant TACSTD2 vs CD8 rho=+0.19, p=0.40. tLung epithelial TACSTD2 vs NK rho=-0.65, p=0.032 (n=11, not replicated in mixed origins).
honest_split.composition_adjusted: Partial Spearman of all-cell TACSTD2 vs CD8 given epithelial/tumor fraction: tLung rho=+0.19, p=0.57; mixed origins rho=-0.36, p=0.029. GSE207422 all-cell TACSTD2 vs epithelial fraction rho=0.80; vs CD8 rho=-0.61; partial given tumor fraction rho=+0.06.

caveats: GSE131907 author 'Malignant cells' calls are absent from all 11 primary tLung samples; malignant labels live in metastases/EBUS. Epithelial fraction is the honest primary-tumor proxy.
n=11 primary tumors is underpowered for CD8/NK.
GSE207422 cell types are marker-score lineage calls, not author annotations or CNV-malignant calls.
Expression used log1p(UMI), not library-size CPM.

A11.claim: Galectin / Nectin / TGFb / CD47 travel with TACSTD2-high
A11.verdict: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED for CD47 and NECTIN2; Galectins mixed; TGFb not consistent at sample level

by_axis.CD47: Most consistent. GSE131907 malignant cells rho=0.55; malignant-sample means n=21 rho=0.86 p=5.9e-7; TCGA-LUAD bulk rho=0.26 p=2.5e-9 (holds after partial EPCAM). TCGA-LUSC bulk NS.
by_axis.Nectin: NECTIN2/PVRL2 supported (malignant cells 0.45; malignant samples 0.56 p=0.009; GSE207422 epithelial cells 0.55). PVR weaker and sign-flips in TCGA-LUAD (rho=-0.18). NECTIN1/3/4 absent from GSE131907 matrix (only PVRL2 present).
by_axis.Galectin: LGALS3/LGALS9 positive at cell level and some sample tests (malignant-sample LGALS9 rho=0.51 p=0.019; TCGA-LUAD LGALS3 0.38). LGALS1 weaker. Dropout-inflated at single-cell level.
by_axis.TGFb: NOT a robust TACSTD2 partner at sample level. Malignant-sample TGFB1 rho~0. Cell-level TGFB1 ~0.22. TCGA-LUAD TGFB1 0.15 / TGFB2 0.26. GSE207422 pretreatment bulk TGFB1 is negative (rho=-0.45, p=0.027).

A11.specificity: EPCAM and CLDN4 correlate with TACSTD2 more strongly than the immune-checkpoint cassette. A11 is partly an epithelial/junctional state, not a specific Galectin-Nectin-TGFb-CD47 module.
caveats: Cell-level Spearman on zero-inflated UMI overstates concordance.
Sample-level malignant means exclude primary tLung because the atlas did not call malignant cells there.
Bulk TCGA is composition-confounded; partial EPCAM is only a partial fix.

A7.claim: Hunt public paired pre/post ICI TROP2 IHC or RNA (Zhejiang is private)
A7.verdict: NO public paired pre/post ICI TROP2 IHC dataset. NO public same-patient paired ICI TROP2 RNA matrix. Zhejiang remains private.
A7.closest_public: GSE207422 NSCLC neoadjuvant PD-1 + chemo scRNA: 3 pretreatment + 12 posttreatment from different patients (0 pairs). Unpaired TACSTD2_all median 0.33 pre vs 0.10 post, MW p=0.23. Epithelial TACSTD2 0.95 vs 0.60, p=0.54. Deposited bulk RNA is pretreatment only (24 samples); MPR vs NMPR TACSTD2 p=0.34.
other_public_ICI_RNA_not_paired: GSE126044 n=16 pretreatment; TACSTD2 responder vs non-responder p=0.58
GSE135222 n=27 pretreatment; TACSTD2 present as ENSG00000184292; no post RNA
POPLAR/OAK TACSTD2 vs atezolizumab outcome is pretreatment and EGA-controlled
A7.paired_TROP2_IHC_that_is_not_ICI: Inoue et al. 160 paired lung TROP2 IHC (76% unchanged) but only 5 patients received ICI. JCO 2025 abs 8591 (n=51) reports 29.4% TROP2 H-score change after mixed systemic therapy; data not public and not ICI-stratified.
